landing.heroSubtitle: Streamline strategic sourcing, enforce real-time SOX 404 dual-signoff policies, and evaluate multi-supplier bid matrices with enterprise AI intelligence.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Engineered for Chief Procurement Officers, Corporate Controllers, and Strategic Sourcing Teams.
landing.f1Desc: Automated delegation gatekeeping halting purchase orders exceeding single-signatory authority limits without Form CS-8 Sole-Source justifications.
landing.f2Desc: Multi-dimensional supplier scoring blending total cost of ownership (TCO), ESG ratings, logistics lead times, and warranty benchmarks.
landing.f3Desc: Server-side Gemini 3.8 Flash inference contextualized with organizational spend history, vendor master data, and fiduciary limits.
landing.f4Desc: FIDO2 hardware token verification and immutable audit event logs ensuring tamper-proof compliance across every requisition.
landing.f5Desc: Granular Firestore security rules with tenant isolation, strict role-based access control (RBAC), and real-time synchronization.
landing.f6Desc: Full bidirectional support for Modern Standard Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR) with localized formatting and BiDi string isolation.
landing.quoteText: "Synthetix transformed our enterprise procurement cycle from 18 days of fragmented email approvals into a 3-hour compliant workflow."
landing.footerRights: All rights reserved. Enterprise AI Sourcing Architecture.
